name: Kitchen-Board
description: A family wall board for shopping, meals, calendars, chores and timers

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database (kitchenboard.db), nightly backups, uploaded photos and .secret_key, this install's own sign-in key made on first start. Back this folder up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Kitchen Board web app, published on host as 6179

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: The email you sign in with as the first admin. Replace CHANGEME@example.com with your own. Only used on the very first start.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Optional. The first admin's password, at least 8 characters. Leave it empty and Kitchen Board makes one and prints it in the app log on the line with "Password:". Only used on the very first start.
